rules.entry: 1h EMA20 vs EMA60 trend; closed 15m close breaks prior 20-bar high/low; max 2 positions per direction
rules.exit: closed 15m close crosses 1h ATR14 trailing stop (3.0x from extreme since entry), or 1h trend against position on 2 consecutive closed 1h bars
